boundsSource: Leaflet MapContainer getBounds() reported on mount and on moveend, zoomend, and resize.

inclusion.geometry: Cell point coordinates only; do not include radius or coverage overlap.
inclusion.edges: Inclusive south/north and west/east edges, with 1e-10 degree floating-point tolerance.
inclusion.longitudeWrap: Supports bounds crossing the antimeridian and bounds spanning at least 360 degrees.

snapshot: Store ordered Cell IDs and the captured bounds in ephemeral inventorySession state.
stability: Map movement does not change captured membership. It shows Map moved when bounds differ at six-decimal-degree precision. Current tower records are resolved by ID, so profile/location edits remain live; deleted IDs are omitted.
refresh: Refresh area captures the current bounds and current Cell IDs and resets paging and batch selection.
emptyState: If no IDs were captured, show a map-area empty state with pan/zoom then Refresh area guidance.
e2eEvidence: Inventory Search, Map area, and empty Network remain bounded working sets; 1440px captured Map area working set screenshot
